audience: fleet operators who track vehicles with flespi telematics devices

useCases.title: Find trackers that went silent
useCases.text: List the devices with their protocols, then read the latest telemetry values of the devices you check.

useCases.title: Read recent device messages
useCases.text: List the devices to find a selector, then read the most recent stored messages of a device.

useCases.title: Review geofences and groups
useCases.text: List the geofences and the device groups that organize the fleet.

useCases.title: Check channels, calculators and streams
useCases.text: List the ingestion channels, the calculators and the outgoing streams with their settings.

useCases.title: Register a new tracker
useCases.text: Create a device from its IMEI and a device type, then rename it with an update.
